dt: Last listed deadline Nov 1, 2026 (AAS Job Register); search copies of the AAS ad say applications are considered on a rolling basis, and the NTNU Physics notice gives no deadline
e: Numerical methods for gravitational equations and solar-system dynamics. Needs a PhD in physics, math or CS with ODE-numerics skills.
f: NTNU Physics, Center for Astronomy and Gravity; PI David M. Hernandez
n: National Taiwan Normal U.: Computational gravitational dynamics postdoc
unv: The AAS Job Register blocks automated access (HTTP 403), so the AAS ad was not read after its Nov 1 deadline. The NTNU Physics notice (Jan 6, 2026; read Nov 9, 2026) invites applicants to contact Prof. Hernandez, gives no deadline and does not say the post is filled.
